Helper-claimed by Claude while Codex completes higher-priority work.

Ready for review: staging/prod BFF local snapshot fallback is explicitly disabled; control compose removes BFF cross-service read volumes; memory read surface uses HTTP service client; focused pytest and docker compose config pass.

Changes requested: memory HTTP read client must normalize the real services/memory API shape (flat source_event_type/source_event_id/scope/scope_filter/reuse_count/superseded_by) into the BFF KW-01 contract. Current projection only understands nested snapshot shape, so service-backed scope filters, reuse_count, supersession, and source_context degrade incorrectly. Add/adjust tests to mock the real memory service response shape, then rerun focused BFF tests and docker compose config.

Memory HTTP read client now normalizes the real services/memory flat API shape into KW-01 summaries/details, including source_event_type/source_event_id, scope/scope_filter, reuse_count, and superseded_by.
